title: Endpoint-witness form of scalar finite boundary composition
statement: For the same prime, finite coefficient field, normalized Chern data, integral arrow and level as in the scalar finite boundary composition, the finiteBoundaryEquality predicate holds for the finite quotient, finite root map, evaluated scalar arrow and underlying integral evaluation. This is the endpoint-witness form before extracting the homogeneous composition equality.

source.place: clause (2), endpoint transport and evaluation calculation

proof.text: Transpose the scalar-extended arrow through the normalized scalar adjunction, apply exact finite evaluation and restriction of scalars, and use the section, restriction and morphism equations of the specified Forget structure. The integer-section characterization of finiteQuotient and the pure-tensor characterization of finiteRootMap supply the two endpoint witnesses; naturality of the single and shift comparisons gives the final finiteBoundaryEquality witness.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), endpoint transport and evaluation calculation

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem for arbitrary integral arrows; this is the endpoint-witness split of the item proof.

from.place: proof clause (2), endpoint transport and evaluation calculation

lean.statement:
theorem scalarFiniteBoundary_boundaryEquality (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (hc : unitNormalization c.scalar.T
      (SemilinearSections.res.{u + 1, u, u + 1} (coefficientSystemMap l E T))
      c.scalar.adjunction c.scalarUnit (scalarGenerator l E T))
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteBoundaryEquality
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).map (finiteQuotient l E T n))
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).map
        (finiteRootMap l E T n)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧')
      (scalarFiniteBoundary_eval l E c f n)
      (scalarFiniteBoundary_integral l E c f n)
